deposit.context: Savings history: a deposit (money put onto an account).

interest.context: Savings history: interest paid by the bank.

adjustment.context: Savings history: a correction to match the bank's balance.

transfer.context: Savings history: money moved between accounts.

spending.context: Savings history: money spent from a goal, taken off the account it was on.

forGoal.context: Savings history: which goal a movement was for. Lowercase fragment.

deleteBoth.context: Savings history: confirm deleting a transfer, which removes both of its sides.

deleteLabel.context: Savings history: accessible label of the bin button.
